uiModel.dataSources: Client component fetches GET /api/production/projects/{projectId} once per mount (+ explicit Reload). Uses: activeStoryRevisionId, activeAudioMixRevisionId, audioMixVersion, dependencyIssues, storyRevision.beats (id/narration/dialogue[].text), audioMixRevision (nullable), animaticRevision.totalFrames (nullable). activeStoryRevisionId null -> fail-closed empty state 'Save a script revision before placing audio cues' + link to project page; no editor.
uiModel.assetCatalog: deriveMixCatalog(readModel, sessionAssets): union of (a) in-session upload responses (full Asset) and (b) assets referenced by the active mix cues (assetId + per-cue sourceRights ONLY — read model exposes no asset records). Recovered (b) entries render provenance 'unavailable until re-imported', support NO new-cue creation and NO trim beyond the cue's known sourceEndSample. Frozen read-model limitation, not a UI choice (proposal filed in decisions).
uiModel.uploadStateMachine: phase 'idle'|'uploading'|'failed'|'ready'. idle: file input, source (required nonempty), rightsAttestation (required nonempty), rightsStatus select restricted to creator_attested|licensed|public_domain (route's only legal values). uploading: submit disabled + busy text. ready: ONLY on 2xx WITH parsed asset (deriveUploadOutcome never returns ready without an asset — blank-success guard). failed: any non-2xx, network error, or unparseable body -> role=alert with envelope error.code + error.message + requestId (or 'network error'), form values and file retained, Retry enabled. deriveUploadOutcome maps INVALID_INPUT(400)/MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE(422)/413 to actionable text.
uiModel.previewSeek: In-session uploaded files only: HTMLAudioElement + URL.createObjectURL(file); durationSamples = asset.audioSamples; play/pause + seek range input (min 0 max durationSamples step 1) wired to currentTime; samplesToDisplayTime(samples) = integer math `${Math.trunc(samples/48000)}.${String(samples%48000).padStart(3,'0')}s` (no floating-point seconds in stored values). Recovered assets: explicit 'Preview unavailable — re-import the file in this session' state.
uiModel.cueEditorModel: CueDraft = {key (client row id); assetId; role 'narration'|'dialogue'|'music'|'sfx'; timelineStartSample int>=0; sourceStartSample int>=0; sourceEndSample int>start; gainDb clamped [-60,12]; scriptSegmentId string|null; sourceText string|null; sourceRights}. New cues default music/sfx; narration/dialogue require picking a script beat. Editing = sample-number inputs with per-field clamps + keyboard-focusable cue rows; selecting a beat auto-fills sourceText from beat.narration (narration) or a chosen beat.dialogue[].text line (dialogue) — the exact equality narrationAlignmentIssues enforces.
uiModel.saveReadiness: deriveCueSaveReadiness(drafts, catalog, context {projectId, activeStoryRevisionId, audioMixVersion, storyRevision, animaticTotalSamples number|null}): {ok:true; command:SaveAudioMixCommand} | {ok:false; issues:CueIssue[]}. CueIssue = {cueKey; kind 'MISSING_ASSET'|'SOURCE_RANGE'|'GAIN'|'OVERLAP'|'ALIGNMENT'|'OVERFLOW'|'STALE_STORY'; message}. Pipeline reuses accepted domain code verbatim: per-draft buildAudioCue (throw -> caught -> issue with exact message), validateCueOverlaps(cues,'layered'), narrationAlignmentIssues — zero reimplementation of server rules; nonempty issues disables Save and renders every message (fail-closed preflight). mixSettings UI defaults {sampleRate:48000, channels:2, loudnessTargetLufs:-14, truePeakLimitDbtp:-1, muteNativeAudio:true}. Save POSTs SaveAudioMixCommand {projectId, expectedAudioVersion, expectedStoryRevisionId, cues, mixSettings} JSON same-origin. Success 201/200: banner names revision.id + created flag, refetch read model. STALE_REVISION 409: alert 'The audio mix or script changed; reload to continue' — drafts retained. Other errors rendered like upload failures; NEVER a success state without the parsed revision.
uiModel.overflowRule: Two tiers: (1) hard always: sourceEndSample > asset.audioSamples (or known max for recovered cues) blocks Save naming the cue row, offending count, and asset bound in samples AND seconds; (2) when animaticRevision exists: cue timeline end (timelineStartSample + (sourceEndSample-sourceStartSample)) > totalFrames*2000 (C11-PRE frozen) blocks Save with actionable trim/move message. No animatic -> tier 2 not evaluated (matches server behavior).
uiModel.staleNarrationRendering: deriveStaleNarrationNotices(readModel): ordered rows from (a) mix pinned to previous story revision -> MIX_STORY_PINNED naming both ids; (b) deriveStaleDependencyNotices(dependencyIssues) filtered targetKind==='audio' (reused verbatim); (c) narrationAlignmentIssues(activeMix, storyRevision.beats) per-cue STALE_STORY/UNKNOWN_SEGMENT/TEXT_DRIFT. Rendered in a distinct 'Stale narration' region role=status above the editor whenever nonempty; never hidden, never auto-repaired.
uiModel.timelineView: Read-only active-mix rendering via serializeAudioTimeline(audioMixRevision) for ordered rows {id, role, timelineStartSample, timelineEndSample, gainDb, scriptSegmentId, sourceRights} + totalEndSample; per-row rights/source metadata (session provenance when asset in session catalog; recovered rows show cue-level sourceRights + 'provenance unavailable until re-imported').
uiModel.visualAndA11yConventions: Existing tailwind + components/ui primitives (Button/Badge patterns as in app/story/page.tsx); no new design system, no global CSS changes. Every interactive control keyboard-reachable with visible text or aria-label; upload alert / stale region / save issues use role=alert|status; file input has a proper <label>; focus order follows DOM order.
